objective: Slay Hetaera and bring back Hetaera's Bloodied Head, Hetaera's Beaten Head, and Hetaera's Bruised Head to Lord Arkkoroc.

description: She kills my children, mortal. She that calls herself the ruler of these oceans. A false god, nothing more. Crush her and bring back all of her heads.
For that, you will be given the name that you seek and something else of equal importance.
She roams the clutch... Hetaera she is called.
progress: <Lord Arkkoroc bends down to inspect you.>
completion: Finally, one worthy of the wisdom of Arkkoroc!
